page_convention: 1-based physical source PDF pages, equal to printed page numbers

full_scientific_text_read.reading_method: Complete extracted text read in this scientific Chat, with actual page images checked separately; parsing alone was not counted as reading.

coverage.subject: Model, effective resistance, hypotheses and theorem quantifiers
checks: All nearest-neighbour edges retained with unit conductance; independent optional long edges at beta>0.
Integrated kernel yields lambda_d=log(d^2/(d^2-1)); sum_{d>=2}lambda_d=log2.
Flow antisymmetry, source/sink contraction, constrained versus ordinary flow energies distinguished.
Exponent depends only on beta; prefactor may depend on beta and epsilon; all integer N; second conclusion conditional on no inner-to-outer direct edge.
coverage.outcome: Hypotheses used in counterexamples verified; no main conclusion refuted.

coverage.subject: Cut-edge heuristic, two exit portions and constrained resistance
checks: Two deterministic edge-disjoint nearest-neighbour exit paths disprove the single-edge cut event as defined.
Direct exit caveat on p.4 explicitly considered as counterevidence.
Constrained edge masks and source/terminal conventions carried into exact networks.
coverage.outcome: P4 local impossibility; P5 quantified local missing event; notation fixed for review.

coverage.subject: Good intervals, firework domination and dependent concentration
checks: Long-edge shell sets and stated independence examined.
Dominating distribution tilde_alpha(s)=(1-3/(2^(s+1)+2))^(2beta) is a nonnegative iid radius CDF with positive zero mass, exponential tail and positive infinite product.
Gallo Proposition1 and its hypotheses checked in original reference pp.2-3; proof route pp.6-7 examined; full ten-page reference text read.
Mixed-moment Chernoff derivation independently reconstructed; no independence of Bernoulli indicators needed beyond mixed-moment bound.
coverage.outcome: Reference supports tail statement; source minimum-index/range translation and evident index/sign inconsistencies must be corrected consistently. These are not multiplied into additional findings.

coverage.subject: Quantiles, exposed entrance edges, interval masks and very-good events
checks: Quantile convention a_alpha,j and upper bounds q+1 checked for j>=2.
General terminal-shrinking claim tested with exact graph, yielding5 versus11/6.
Actual fixed-gap/fixed-mask monotonicity uses established by inclusion of admissible flow classes.
Conditioning sigma-field and shared optional-edge dependence explicitly enumerated.
coverage.outcome: P3 Minor with restricted repair; P1 exact conditional-independence counterexample.

coverage.subject: Core many-scale probability estimate
checks: Positive-probability complete crossing-edge configurations meet model and entrance-index definitions.
At beta=1/20, joint/product conditional ratio (9/8)^(1/20)>1.
At beta=1/200 and four admissible scales, exposed edges force resistance tests(3) to fail even when all good tests(1) occur.
Example parameters satisfy displayed scale construction; no assertion they equal later sufficiently-large parameter choices.
Positive association, typo corrections, and possible averaging considered as alternative repairs.
coverage.outcome: P1 Major proof gap. Unconditional conclusion of Lemma3.8 and main theorem not disproved. Replacement conditional or averaged tail proof remains unverified.

coverage.subject: Scale growth and terminal-margin event
checks: Fixed-parameter d_k grows on order k log k, so sum 1/d_k diverges.
Entrance-margin event and dependence of k0 on beta and alpha examined.
Endpoint and dyadic range roles checked against source images.
coverage.outcome: Conditional use in recurrence tracked; no new proved defect.

coverage.subject: Path partition, mass passage and energy aggregation
checks: Exact minimizing flow for N=4 with shortcut(0,2) gives path weights1/3,2/3; literal path membership totals4/3.
First-entry classes partition acyclic electrical paths and preserve orientation, restoring Eq.(3.28).
Lemma3.14 passage and Lemma3.15 mass arguments checked with first-entry interpretation; interval disjointness in Lemma3.16 checked.
All color Figures6-9 viewed and compared with literal formulas.
coverage.outcome: P2 Minor with local repair verified. Full independent aggregate-energy accounting, including aggregate first-entry classes and boundary-edge charges, not established; no additional defect inferred from this coverage limit.

coverage.subject: Recursive quantiles and beta-only exponent
checks: Finite partial sum of 1/d_k chosen large, then positive delta with exp(delta*d_M)<2.
Induction lower bound reconstructed under the assumed recurrence.
Fixed alpha=1/2 removes epsilon dependence of exponent; small n handled by positive finite quantiles.
coverage.outcome: Downstream implication checked conditionally; cannot supply missing upstream P1 proof.

coverage.subject: Reflection coupling and point-to-exterior bound
checks: Reflected edge probabilities compared using actual endpoint distances and fixed-terminal masks.
Allowed-edge monotonicity used with terminals fixed.
N=8 direct-exit network computed exactly: resistance9/11, side portions1/11 each.
No-direct-exit event has probability (N/(N+1))^(2beta); union bound <=2beta/N; epsilon budget and finitely many small N handled.
coverage.outcome: Coupling checked conditionally; P5 Minor with local repair conditional on preceding resistance lemma.

coverage.subject: Conditional box-to-box bound and nondyadic extension
checks: Direct inner-to-outer edge absence explicitly retained.
Truncated resistance variables do not use those forbidden edges; conditional independence Eq.(4.10) checked.
Dyadic flow split compared to fixed-source point case.
coverage.outcome: General nondyadic box-to-box extension not independently proved. This is a stated limit, not an asserted defect.

coverage.subject: References, version scope and counterevidence
checks: Relevant primary firework statement verified; standard concentration use independently derived.
Publisher journal metadata associated with DOI; 34-page journal proof text not compared.
Bounded correction search found metadata but no correction text, not an exhaustive absence claim.
No author code run; lack of released code not treated as a mathematical defect.
coverage.outcome: Version-limited initial review; scientific decision pending, human reviews empty.

independent_checks.method: reviewer-authored exact rational grounded-Laplacian solves, telescoping rational products, analytic event probabilities and deterministic connectivity; floating-point displays illustrative only

unresolved_limits: Publisher journal proof text not compared.
Unconditional replacement multi-scale estimate for P1 unverified.
Complete aggregate-energy argument after first-entry correction not independently re-proved.
General nondyadic box-to-box extension not independently established.
severity_policy: No Major quota. P2 was reduced from Major to Minor after verifying its local first-entry repair; uncertainty in a larger repair was not treated as a proved defect.

independent_acceptance.scope: Focused independent verification of all five reported Problems, exact model and masks, quantifiers, counterexamples, conditional-probability distinctions, local repairs and core dependency chain; no new whole-paper review.
